audience: German freelancers and small businesses who do invoicing and bookkeeping with Papierkram

useCases.title: See which invoices are still unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists outgoing invoices with state, dates, totals and outstanding amount, filtered by company, project or date range, and adds up what is open.

useCases.title: Review expense vouchers of a supplier
useCases.text: The AI lists expense vouchers filtered by creditor, project or document date range, with state and amounts, and opens one with its line items.

useCases.title: Check tracked hours on a project
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries by project, task, user or billing state and adds up the hours that are not billed yet.

useCases.title: Check bank connections and transactions
useCases.text: The AI lists the connected bank accounts and their transactions with value, booking date, usage text and counterparty.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft invoice or add a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft invoice for a customer with a payment term, or adds a company contact. A draft is not final or sent until you complete it in Papierkram.

useCases.title: Create a project and task, then record time
useCases.text: The AI creates a project and a task if needed, then records a time entry of worked time on the task. It is not billed until an invoice is made.
